checks.instructions: Use arrows and WASD to move one cell, face cargo and press Space. Verify numbered route and blue rear ruler match the launch. Use Z to undo and R to retry the current bay.
Solve all eight rooms, including crate backstops, repeated helper use and moving a delivered crate. Check a deadlock stays undoable; rejected routes never move cargo.
Inspect native 2D loading-bay grid, target visibility, exact landing, first-obstruction X, progress, start/pause/final panels at normal and resized windows.
K saves; change cargo and undo history, then L loads. Confirm current bay, facing, cargo, undo and subsequent play resume exactly.
Listen for cargo launch and delivery cues; exercise M mute and focus/pause. Software captures do not prove physical audio.
